items.reason: The inclusion criteria say "glioma (grade II-IV) showing enhancement on post-contrast MRI" and "brain metastases". Grade IV is explicitly allowed, there is no IDH requirement, and glioblastoma is never named in an eligible field. That is the D30-R7 pattern, but R7 is worded for grade 3-4, and this range starts at grade II.
D30-R7 includes ranges that explicitly allow grade 4 glioma with no IDH requirement as historical glioblastoma (D27C), even when glioblastoma is not named.

note: The population question is moot for inclusion: the record is Phase NA (fails S3), and the only agent is the diagnostic tracer 68Ga-PSMA-11 (fails S6). XL may want to confirm that D30-R7 extends to 'grade II-IV' ranges for consistency across trials. D31-B15 does not apply because glioblastoma is not named in the eligibility population (only 'glioma (grade II-IV)' and brain metastases); the grade II-IV extension of D30-R7 is not settled by D31-B1/B3 but is moot (fails S3 and S6).
